# KaTeX fonts 0.16.11

The WOFF and WOFF2 fonts in `dist/fonts` are copied without modification from
the official npm package `katex@0.16.11`:
https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.16.11.tgz

The package's published SHA-512 integrity was verified before extraction:
`sha512-RQrI8rlHY92OLf3rho/Ts8i/XvjgguEjOkO1BEXcU3N8BqPpSzBNwV/G0Ukr+P/l3ivvJUE/Fa/CwbS6HesGNQ==`

See `LICENSE` for the upstream MIT license and copyright notice.
Only font assets are bundled; the project's JavaScript and CSS are not replaced.
This is a pinned fallback version, not a claim that every textbook uses KaTeX 0.16.11.
